name: Hand Painted Nurse Resin Figurine (5.9 Inch)
seoTitle: Hand Painted Nurse Figurine Gift for Nurses
metaDescription: A small hand painted nurse figurine with a love to share theme, a sweet keepsake for a nurse's desk, bookshelf, or new grad display.
summary: A small hand painted nurse figure that works as a lasting keepsake, especially for graduations, retirements, or a heartfelt thank you.
whyItWorks: Some gifts get used up, and some stay on a shelf for twenty years. A figurine falls firmly in the second group, and that is the point. For a nurse finishing school, retiring after a long career, or someone who cared for a family member through a hard stretch, a small statue says thanks in a way that sticks around.

At 5.9 inches tall it is a comfortable size for a desk, a nightstand, or a bookshelf next to a framed diploma or pinning photo. Hand painted details give it more character than a mass printed trinket, and the love to share theme keeps the message warm rather than corny. Families sometimes look for a meaningful thank you after a hospital stay, and something like this can be handed to a unit manager or set at the nurses station for the whole team to enjoy. Add a handwritten card about what their care meant and it will carry real weight.
goodToKnow: Resin can chip if dropped, so it is better for a home shelf than a busy workstation.
Check the listing photos for the exact pose and colors, since it is a display piece.
It pairs well with a card or a framed photo from graduation or pinning.

faq.q: Is a figurine a good graduation gift for a new nurse?
faq.a: It can be, especially for someone who likes keepsakes. It marks the milestone and will still be on display years later.

faq.q: Can a patient's family give this to a nurse?
faq.a: Yes, it is a common kind of thank you gift. Hospitals sometimes have gift policies, so giving it to the unit as a whole can be a nice option.
